_comment: NVFP4 checkpoint imported verbatim (import_encoded, no re-quantization of packed codes). input_path is still the original BF16 safetensors directory: the recipes read the BF16 embedding and other non-packed tensors from --model; the NVFP4 weights are the quantized source. Pick the nvfp4 recipe variant that matches your checkpoint's layout: qwen3_8_27b_nvfp4 (compressed-tensors), _nvidia (ModelOpt AutoQuant) or _orcarouter (GPTQ). NVFP4 output is 4.25 bpw and cannot be re-quantized to other widths on this route; jailbreak on NVFP4 input is refused.
